summary.text: Aumua Amata Radewagen, a Republican, was elected American Samoa's third Member of Congress on November 4, 2014.

paragraphs.text: She was the first woman to represent American Samoa in the U.S. House of Representatives.
She serves on the House Veterans' Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Natural Resources committees.
Since 2019 she has served on the President's Commission for Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders.
